Interpolation is not layer compositing

CSS can explicitly interpolate colors and gradients in Oklab or OKLCH. Browser normal compositing remains source-over; it does not interpolate the backdrop and source in Oklab. “CSS / Oklab” below is the CSS Color interpolation model evaluated per pixel.

How to read this page

Raw OKLCH follows the shorter hue arc and hard-clips display RGB. It exposes the neutral-axis detour.

Krita current patch applies the cubic toe only to lightness after polar interpolation.

Toe + COFb radially transforms all Oklab components, then blends polar and Cartesian paths with w=C/(C+σ).

Local MINDE follows the CSS Color 4 binary-search reference: reduce OKLCH chroma until clipping changes the color by less than one Oklab JND.

Endpoint-aware hybrid additionally fades the polar contribution as either endpoint’s transformed chroma approaches zero, addressing COFb’s documented residual achromatic-endpoint bow.
